name: Knight of the Ashened City
desc: If "Obsidim, the Ashened City" is in the Field Zone, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Knight of the Ashened City" once per turn this way. If this card is Summoned: You can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Fusion Summon 1 Pyro Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand, Deck, or field as Fusion Material. If this card is used as material for a Fusion Summon, and sent to the GY or banished: You can add 1 "Ashened" or "Veidos" card from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Knight of the Ashened City" once per turn.
